tools.name: sevdesk_get_bookkeeping_system_version
tools.description: Return whether the account runs sevdesk bookkeeping 1.0 or 2.0 (2.0 uses taxRule instead of taxType on invoices). Also a cheap way to confirm the API token works. sevdesk: GET /Tools/bookkeepingSystemVersion.

tools.name: sevdesk_list_contacts
tools.description: List contacts (customers, suppliers, partners, prospects). By default sevdesk returns only organisations; set include_persons to also get individual persons. sevdesk: GET /Contact.

tools.name: sevdesk_get_contact
tools.description: Fetch a single contact by id. sevdesk: GET /Contact/{contactId}.

tools.name: sevdesk_list_communication_ways
tools.description: List communication ways (email addresses, phone and mobile numbers, websites), optionally for one contact. sevdesk: GET /CommunicationWay.

tools.name: sevdesk_list_communication_way_keys
tools.description: List the labels a communication way can carry (1 Privat, 2 Arbeit, 3 Fax, 4 Mobil, 6 Autobox, 7 Newsletter, 8 Rechnungsadresse). Needed for sevdesk_add_communication_way. sevdesk: GET /CommunicationWayKey.

tools.name: sevdesk_list_invoices
tools.description: List invoices, filterable by status, number, date range and contact. Status: 50 deactivated recurring, 100 draft, 200 open/due, 750 partially paid, 1000 paid. sevdesk: GET /Invoice.

tools.name: sevdesk_get_invoice
tools.description: Fetch a single invoice by id — totals, status, dates, contact and contact person. sevdesk: GET /Invoice/{invoiceId}.

tools.name: sevdesk_get_invoice_positions
tools.description: List the positions (line items) of one invoice: name, quantity, price, tax rate, sums. sevdesk: GET /Invoice/{invoiceId}/getPositions.

tools.name: sevdesk_list_vouchers
tools.description: List vouchers — receipts and incoming/outgoing bills. Status: 50 draft, 100 unpaid/due, 1000 paid. credit_debit C = credit (revenue), D = debit (expense). sevdesk: GET /Voucher.

tools.name: sevdesk_get_voucher
tools.description: Fetch a single voucher (receipt) by id. sevdesk: GET /Voucher/{voucherId}.

tools.name: sevdesk_list_credit_notes
tools.description: List credit notes (Gutschriften), filterable by status, number, date range and contact. Status: 100 draft, 200 open/delivered, 750 partially paid, 1000 paid. sevdesk: GET /CreditNote.

tools.name: sevdesk_list_orders
tools.description: List orders — quotes (Angebote), order confirmations and delivery notes — filterable by status, number, date range and contact. Status: 100 draft, 200 delivered, 300 rejected, 500 accepted, 750 partially calculated, 1000 calculated. sevdesk: GET /Order.

tools.name: sevdesk_list_parts
tools.description: List parts — the products and services in the sevdesk inventory, with prices, tax rate and stock. sevdesk: GET /Part.

tools.name: sevdesk_list_check_accounts
tools.description: List check accounts — the bank accounts, cash registers and clearing accounts sevdesk tracks payments on, with IBAN, type and sync status. sevdesk: GET /CheckAccount.

tools.name: sevdesk_get_check_account_balance
tools.description: Balance of one check account as the sum of every transaction sevdesk knows up to and including the given date. May differ from the real bank balance if older transactions were never imported. sevdesk: GET /CheckAccount/{checkAccountId}/getBalanceAtDate.

tools.name: sevdesk_list_transactions
tools.description: List check-account transactions (bank payments in and out), filterable by account, booking state, date range, payee/payer and purpose. sevdesk: GET /CheckAccountTransaction.

tools.name: sevdesk_create_contact
tools.description: Create a contact. Give `name` for an organisation, or `surename`/`familyname` for a person. Addresses and emails are separate (use sevdesk_add_communication_way). sevdesk: POST /Contact.

tools.name: sevdesk_update_contact
tools.description: Update fields on an existing contact; only the fields you pass are sent. sevdesk: PUT /Contact/{contactId}.

tools.name: sevdesk_add_communication_way
tools.description: Attach an email address, phone/mobile number or website to a contact. key_id labels it (2 Arbeit/work is a good default; see sevdesk_list_communication_way_keys). sevdesk: POST /CommunicationWay.

tools.name: sevdesk_create_draft_invoice
tools.description: Create a normal invoice (type RE) with its line items, ALWAYS saved as a DRAFT (status 100): it is not sent, not booked and stays editable in sevdesk. contact_person_id is the sevdesk USER responsible for it — copy contactPerson.id from any existing invoice (sevdesk_get_invoice). Bookkeeping 2.0 acc

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: sevdesk_list_communication_ways, sevdesk_create_draft_invoice · Private data: sevdesk_get_bookkeeping_system_version, sevdesk_list_contacts, sevdesk_get_contact, sevdesk_list_communication_ways, sevdesk_list_invoices, sevdesk_get_invoice, sevdesk_list_credit_notes, sevdesk_list_orders, sevdesk_create_contact, sevdesk_update_contact, sevdesk_add_communication_way · Public sink: sevdesk_list_communication_ways, sevdesk_create_contact, sevdesk_add_communication_way, sevdesk_create_draft_invoice.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: sevdesk_list_communication_ways, sevdesk_create_draft_invoice · Private data: sevdesk_get_bookkeeping_system_version, sevdesk_list_contacts, sevdesk_get_contact, sevdesk_list_communication_ways, sevdesk_list_invoices, sevdesk_get_invoice, sevdesk_list_credit_notes, sevdesk_list_orders, sevdesk_create_contact, sevdesk_update_contact, sevdesk_add_communication_way · Public sink: sevdesk_list_communication_ways, sevdesk_create_contact, sevdesk_add_communication_way, sevdesk_create_draft_invoice

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
